expressions.note: 口语中表达「太舒服/太爽了」
expressions.example: A cold drink on a hot day feels so good.

expressions.note: 形容词 disciplined＝有纪律的、自律的
expressions.example: She is very disciplined about her study plan.

expressions.note: 开口前 / 借过 / 引起注意都能用
expressions.example: Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the station?
We can eat Chinese or Italian — it's up to you.

expressions.note: 比 I don't care 礼貌得多
expressions.example: I'm fine with that plan.

expressions.note: 回应 Thank you；熟人也可说 No worries
expressions.example: — Thank you so much! — You're welcome.

expressions.note: 英语没有「加油」对应词，按场景选句
expressions.example: You can do it! Just take your time.

expressions.note: 英语没有直接对应，用致谢表达
expressions.example: Thanks for your hard work today.

expressions.note: 口语常用（虽然语法不规范）
expressions.example: Long time no see! How have you been?

expressions.note: 比 How are you 更随意
expressions.example: Hey, how's it going?
Put your wallet away — it's on me.
Let's go Dutch this time.
Please line up here.

expressions.note: 名词；也可说 stuck in traffic
expressions.example: I'm late because of a traffic jam.
Sorry, I'm in a hurry.
Take your time, there's no rush.

expressions.note: 店员问 Can I help you 时的回答
expressions.example: — Can I help you? — I'm just looking, thanks.
Is there any discount on this one?

expressions.note: 也可说 That's a bit pricey
expressions.example: That's too expensive for me.
Can I try it on?
One coffee to take away, please.

expressions.note: 不说 I've eaten enough 也可
expressions.example: No more for me, I'm full.
Are you ready to order food?
Could we pay the bill, please?

expressions.note: 也可说 I lost my way
expressions.example: I think we got lost.
I can't fall asleep at night.

expressions.note: 强调动作；have a cold 强调状态
expressions.example: I caught a cold yesterday.

expressions.note: 地道口语，指有点不舒服
expressions.example: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today.

expressions.note: 也可说 burn the midnight oil
expressions.example: Don't stay up late too often.
Take it easy this weekend.
Don't worry, I'll handle it.
What a pity you can't come.
— Let's meet at six. — Sounds good.

expressions.note: 强烈同意：I couldn't agree more
expressions.example: I agree with your point.
I don't think so, actually.
Let me think about it and get back to you.
I'll think it over.
He always keeps his word.

expressions.note: 对方激动时用；语气注意柔和
expressions.example: Calm down and tell me what happened.

expressions.note: be used to + 名词/动名词
expressions.example: I'm used to getting up early.
I go to the cinema once in a while.
Give me a second — I'll be right there.

expressions.note: 危险提醒；也可说 Be careful
expressions.example: Watch out! The floor is wet.

expressions.note: 帮忙开门/拿东西时的礼貌语
expressions.example: Let me get that for you.
Sorry to bother you, but could you help me?
That's great news!
I'm not sure if that's correct.
Don't just follow the crowd.
She went all out to win the match.

expressions.en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do
expressions.example: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
